scope: Audit frozen labels and existing signal-time features only. No label replacement, new features, fits, parameter search, fills or production changes.
flag_semantics: Priority review flags, not automatic rejection or owner gold. No flags also does not confirm a sample.
feature_audit: Reuse original chronological OOS events, first event per episode. Scale each original feature by its saved fold's training empirical percentile. Match symbol x side x quarter x training-defined volatility tercile; compare clean versus all nonclean within mixed strata. Equal mixed-stratum weights. No model trained.
uncertainty: 2000 global NY-week cluster bootstrap replicates, recomputing mixed-stratum differences; simultaneous max-standardized-deviation 95% intervals across all 24 features. Descriptive historical association, not prospective validation. Previously inspected 2026 separately checks consistency.
null: 2000 label permutations within matched strata; two-sided absolute statistic, plus-one correction and Holm across 24. Conditional exchangeability is an approximation because market weeks may correlate; cluster intervals are also required. No profit claims from p values.
plots: Three high-quality references from distinct symbols, BTC first then descending frozen quality, each paired with nearest nonclean gallery example of the same symbol and side using initial-training percentiles of the same 24 features. Prefer same calendar year; declare any all-year fallback. Six flagged examples (two per flag where available), deduplicated. Prefix plots use only 60 preceding bars plus signal, with their own causal y range; review plots use original 30+1+29 bars. Figures are not model inputs.
